html:
News Digest:

The size of the global fintech lending market will boom from an estimated $449.89bn in 2020 to $4.95 trillion by 2030, representing a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 27.4% in the coming decade, according to a report published by Allied Market Research.

FinTech worldwide will surge amid a rapid shift from conventional lending to digital lending, increased government initiatives, and focus on digitalization of lending workflows, the report notes.

 

Takeaway:

The expected surge in FinTech adoption around the globe over the next 10 years offers a massive opportunity for investors to ride the digital wave that would increasingly pave the way for new revenue streams to emerge in both mainstream and alternative financial services.
